free_tier.stated: no free tier: dedicated GPUs by the hour, billed per minute, 13 models from $0.20 to $7.50 per GPU-hour. H100 80 GB SXM $2.99 (PCIe $2.75), A100 80 GB $1.49 (PCIe and SXM), L40S $1.00, RTX 4090 $0.45. The page lists no L4.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a GPU-hour, not an object

retention.stated: the home page says models, custom nodes, workflows and outputs are kept in persistent storage for the ComfyUI workspace product; no retention period is stated for GPU instances

egress.terms: the GPU page says 'One rate per GPU hour, whatever you run on it. No instance-type maths, no egress surprises.'; no egress price is published on the pages read

interface_detail: the home page says to connect over SSH with full root access; a web dashboard launches instances. No API is documented on the pages read.
tooling: a web dashboard and SSH with root access on a dedicated GPU; a separate ComfyUI workspace product launches preconfigured image and video workflows on a private GPU. The docs site is built on Mintlify and lists two products, ComfyUI Cloud and GPU Instances.
chaining: unverified: no API, CLI or template route is documented on the pages read, so scripted launches are not established.
limits_note: no session cap, idle reap or quota is published on the pages read; the home page states hourly billing with no minimums
binding_note: no cap is published; the cost is per GPU-hour, billed per minute, with no minimums

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the home page sends the visitor to a dashboard to deploy and the docs do not describe signup; no form was read, so email is the assumed minimum and card, phone and company checks are not established.

reliability_note: unverified: no status page or incident history was read
confidence_note: the hourly rates are read on the vendor's own GPU page on 2026-11-03; the identity cost is unverified
